_meta.purpose: Provincial persona + materialistic/spiritual axis.  Value-orientation axis.  Provincial is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.00, n=4).  Both trait poles' questions ask big-meaning prompts; the axis modulates which frame the persona reaches for.  Question mix: 5 materialistic-trait life-meaning prompts + 4 spiritual-trait same-shape prompts + 2 provincial-role probes + 1 extraction power + 2 hand-written.
